# Agent Reach — English / International Edition

> English-first capability router for AI agents. This fork retains the Agent Reach architecture while removing China-specific integrations and keeping all agent-facing instructions in English.

## Repository

https://github.com/Maxei6/Agent-Reach-English

## Why this fork exists

The upstream Agent Reach project includes Chinese skill text, diagnostics, and documentation. AI agents often load those files directly into context. This fork keeps the same capability model and `agent-reach` CLI but uses English-only agent instructions and removes China-specific channels.

## Retained capabilities

- Any web page via Jina Reader
- Web search via Exa / mcporter
- GitHub via gh CLI
- YouTube via yt-dlp
- Twitter/X
- Reddit
- Facebook
- Instagram
- LinkedIn
- RSS / Atom

## Removed from this edition

Bilibili, XiaoHongShu, Boss Zhipin, V2EX, Xueqiu, Xiaoyuzhou Podcast.

## Core commands

- `agent-reach doctor --json`
- `agent-reach install --env=auto`
- `agent-reach skill --install`
- `agent-reach check-update`

## Agent installation

Install directly from GitHub:

`pipx install --force https://github.com/Maxei6/Agent-Reach-English/archive/main.zip`

Then refresh the skill:

`agent-reach skill --install`

See README.md and docs/install.md for migration details.
